title: TESS light curves (all sectors) at MAST

links.label: TESS light curves (all sectors) at MAST

evidence.locator: DataCite record of the DOI: TESS Light Curves - All Sectors, STScI/MAST, 2021. A file holds one target's 2-minute light curve of a sector, with the flux the mission's pipeline corrected (PDC-MAP).

statements.text: This work includes data collected by the TESS mission, funded by the NASA Explorer Program, obtained from the Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST).
